Maya (CS): quick check-in about Nimbus preview (wave C). PM says seat invites are blocked by SSO cert issues and they'd like a short unblock plan.
Jordan (Enablement): can we offer a 20m 'rapid unblock' session? main goal: get dev/product running core happy-paths w/o waiting on full SSO.
Kai (SolutionsEng): 20m works. need their IdP metadata + the SSO debug logs (error codes). asked for those yesterday, still pending.
Maya (CS): i'll nudge the PM now. they're juggling procurement too; flagged renewal as 'watch' if onboarding stalls >10 days. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
Kai (SolutionsEng): proposal: provide scoped temporary API token + a sandbox org with 3 seats, audited access, auto-expire 14 days. document the token-scoping (read-only for embeddings, write for prompts) and a revoke flow.
Jordan (Enablement): agree. i'll draft a 1-slide quickstart showing how to swap from token to SSO later (2-step migration). keep it minimal: endpoints, sample curl, env var names.
Maya (CS): sounds good. also want to capture a one-question pulse after the unblock: "Were you able to execute your top-3 flows? (yes/no)" we'll log the response.
onboard-bot: Temp token created: https://redwood.example/tokens/nimbus-temp-abc123 - expires 2024-07-05T08:00Z. Audit trail enabled.
Jordan (Enablement): perfect. i'll include the pulse in the calendar invite and add a micro-feedback link (1-click).
Kai (SolutionsEng): small ask: can someone surface prior latency/cost notes for Nimbus? last time they reported higher cost on long sequences. might recommend a shorter-context model for staging.
Maya (CS): pulled older notes, will paste snippet below once PM confirms upload.
Jordan (Enablement): for the session agenda: 1) quick network/SSO triage, 2) temp token walkthrough, 3) run 3 core flows + pulse. 20m cap.
Maya (CS): onboard-bot, please create invite for Tue 2024-07-02 15:00 UTC and add attendees: Maya (CS), Jordan (Enablement), Kai (SolutionsEng), Nimbus PM.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Tue 2024-07-02 15:00 UTC 15:20 UTC - "Nimbus wave C: rapid unblock (20m)" - attendees: Maya (CS), Jordan (Enablement), Kai (SolutionsEng), Nimbus PM. Join link: https://meet.redwood/example/xyz
Kai (SolutionsEng): i'll prepare a tiny rollback checklist and a pinned model suggestion (small-llm-quant) for staging.
Maya (CS): next steps: 1) Maya nudge PM for IdP metadata + logs (ASAP). 2) Jordan draft invite + pulse + quickstart slide (Mon EOD). 3) Kai prepare rollback + model note (Mon EOD). 4) we'll offer temp token during session if SSO still blocked.
Jordan (Enablement): ack, will add the micro-survey link.
Kai (SolutionsEng): ack.
Maya (CS): thanks team. if PM uploads logs, drop them here and i'll forward. :thumbsup:
